title: ADMM-Q: An Improved Hessian-based Weight Quantizer for Post-Training Quantization of Large Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2605.11222v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Quantization is an effective strategy to reduce the storage and computation footprint of large language models (LLMs). Post-training quantization (PTQ) is a leading approach for compressing LLMs. Popular weight quantization procedures, including GPTQ and RTN, suffer in model utility, especially at aggressive quantization levels (sub-4-bit). We propose ADMM-Q, a novel weight quantization algorithm that considers the layer-wise quantization problem. Our algorithm is based on a combinatorial variant of the Alternating Direction Method of Multipliers (ADMM). Our operator-splitting procedure updates weights continuously to minimize the layer-wise reconstruction error, while gradually enforcing the quantization constraints with convergence guarantees. translated_title: ADMM-Q：一种用于大语言模型训练后量化的改进型基于Hessian的权重量化器
translated_abstract: 量化是降低大语言模型（LLM）存储和计算开销的有效策略。训练后量化（PTQ）是压缩大语言模型的主流方法。流行的权重量化方法（包括GPTQ和RTN）在模型效用方面表现不佳，尤其是在激进的量化级别（低于4比特）下。我们提出了ADMM-Q，一种考虑逐层量化问题的创新权重量化算法。我们的算法基于交替方向乘子法（ADMM）的组合变体。我们的算子分裂过程持续更新权重以最小化逐层重构误差，同时逐步施加量化约束并保证收敛性。我们还提出了额外的算法改进（例如惩罚调度、预处理和局部搜索后处理步骤），使ADMM-Q在大语言模型规模下高效运行。ADMM-Q是模块化的……
tldr: ADMM-Q是一种基于ADMM组合变体的新型逐层权重量化算法，通过算子分裂持续优化权重以最小化重构误差并逐步施加量化约束，结合惩罚调度、预处理和局部搜索后处理等改进，在大语言模型低比特（sub-4-bit）训练后量化中显著优于GPTQ和RTN等现有方法。
en_tdlr: ADMM-Q is a novel ADMM-based layer-wise weight quantization algorithm that minimizes layer-wise reconstruction error while gradually enforcing quantization constraints with convergence guarantees, outperforming GPTQ and RTN for sub-4-bit post-training quantization of large language models.
